(1) There shall be established a Governing Board of
the Central Bank (in this Act referred to as the “Governing
Board”)  which  is  charged  with  the  responsibility  of
overseeing the administration and management of the affairs
of the Central Bank and the determination of general policy
of the Central Bank other than the monetary policy.
